_about: Golem's module catalog: what each module offers and what 'Install recommended' takes. Golem manages it; the dock only draws it. Each program: pkg (a nixpkgs attribute) or web (a webapp URL); recommended (in 'Install recommended'); needs (gpu | virt | ram: hidden where the machine lacks it); placement (editorial by default; 'Install recommended' only ever takes editorial entries).
